== Strategy ==

I start with the Ewok Village, and Head for the Medical Frigate. The Frigate lets me get out Insurrection (or Bargaining Table), Strike Planning, and Ewok Celebration.

With Strike Planning I can get into my hand, General Crix Madine and General Solo. Madine can get me Chewbacca the next turn and Chewbacca can get me Lumat and Wuta. Wuta gets me Chief Chirpas Hut.

Then basicly, I play a bunch of Ewoks from either hand or reserve deck, and put Ewoks on Bargaining Table to cancel force drains by sites I dont (and cant) occupy since Ewoks only deploy on Endor. This is a good deck for winning battles and doing force drains.

This is mostly a force drain deck, buttle Battle Plan (or Battle Order) can screw it up a little

[Moderator's note]

HFTMF- Heading for the Medical Frigate
